remarks: Luxury living at its finest! It's rare to find a high floor 2 bedroom corner unit with stunning views. This recently renovated apartment features a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances Quartz countertops, breakfast bar, and an open layout to the living and dining areas. Convenience of washer and dryer in unit! Residents enjoy premium amenities, including a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, community room, shuttle to the train, private green-space for the building, laundry (in addition to in unit washer/dryer), storage, and dry cleaning services. Secure garage parking is available for $118/month per car. Experience the best of downtown living-schedule a tour today!
